title: Design and evaluation of a multiepitope vaccine for pancreatic cancer using immune-dominant epitopes derived from the signature proteome in expression datasets.
authors: Banesh, Sooram; Patil, Nupoor; Chethireddy, Vihadhar Reddy; Bhukmaria, Arnav; Saudagar, Prakash
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计胰腺癌多表位疫苗，基于蛋白表达数据预测表位并模拟与TLR-9的相互作用，核心是免疫原性肽段而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pancreatic cancer is a highly aggressive and often lethal malignancy with limited treatment options. Its late-stage diagnosis and resistance to conventional therapies make it a significant challenge in oncology. Immunotherapy, particularly cancer vaccines, has emerged as a promising avenue for treating pancreatic cancer. Multi-epitope vaccines, designed to target multiple epitopes derived from various antigens associated with pancreatic cancer, have gained attention as potential candidates for improving therapeutic outcomes. In this study, we have explored transcriptomics and protein expression databases to identify potential upregulated proteins in pancreatic cancer cells. After examining a total of 21,054 proteins from various databases, it was discovered that 143 proteins expressed differently in malignant and healthy cells. The CTL, HTL and BCE epitopes were predicted for the shortlisted proteins. 51,840 vaccine constructs were created by concatenating CTL, HTL, and B-cell epitopes in the respective sequences. The best 86 structures were selected from a set of 51,840 designs after they were analyzed for vaxijenicity, allergenicity, toxicity, and antigenicity scores. In further simulation of the immune response using constructs, it was found that 41417, 37961, and 40841 constructs could produce a strong immune response when injected. Further, it was found that construct 37961 showed stronger interaction and stability with TLR-9 as determined from the large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. Moreover, the 37961 construct has shown interactions with TLR-9 suggests its potential in inducing immune response. In addition, construct 37961 has shown 100% predicted solubility in the E. coli expression system. Overall, the study indicates the designed construct 37961 has the potential to induce an anti-tumor immune response and long-standing protection pending further studies.
abstract_zh: 胰腺癌是一种高度侵袭性且通常致命的恶性肿瘤，治疗选择有限。其晚期诊断和对常规疗法的抵抗使其成为肿瘤学中的重大挑战。免疫疗法，特别是癌症疫苗，已成为治疗胰腺癌的有前景途径。多表位疫苗旨在靶向源自胰腺癌相关多种抗原的表位，作为改善治疗结果的潜在候选方案而受到关注。在本研究中，我们探索了转录组学和蛋白质表达数据库，以识别胰腺癌细胞中潜在上调的蛋白质。在检查了来自多个数据库的总共21,054种蛋白质后，发现143种蛋白质在恶性细胞和健康细胞中表达不同。对筛选出的蛋白质预测了CTL、HTL和BCE表位。通过按相应序列连接CTL、HTL和B细胞表位，创建了51,840个疫苗构建体。在分析其vaxijenicity、过敏原性、毒性和抗原性评分后，从51,840个设计中选出了最佳86个结构。在使用构建体进一步模拟免疫反应时，发现41,417、37,961和40,841个构建体在注射后能产生强烈免疫反应。此外，通过大规模分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟确定，构建体37,961与TLR-9表现出更强的相互作用和稳定性。而且，构建体37,961与TLR-9的相互作用表明其具有诱导免疫反应的潜力。另外，构建体37,961在大肠杆菌 (E. coli) 表达系统中显示出100%的预测可溶性。总体而言，该研究表明设计的构建体37,961具有诱导抗肿瘤免疫反应和长期保护的潜力，有待进一步研究。
